description: Send outbound email from the user's @nova.civai.co address (deterministic; no LLM draft).

attachment_drive_ids.description: Workspace Drive file ids to attach (max 5, 2 MB each).

attachments.description: Inline attachments for MCP hosts without Drive (max 5, 2 MB each).

html.description: Optional HTML body (sanitized subset). Used when present.

reply_to_id.description: Nova Inbox storage id of the message being replied to (threads the send).

subject.description: Email subject. Required for new mail; optional when reply_to_id is set.

text.description: Plain-text body. Required if html is omitted.

name: compose_message
